_comment: Contact directory. Add one object per person to "people". Every field except "name" is optional — leave anything out and the card adapts. Groups are rendered in the order listed in "groups"; a person with no group (or an unknown group) falls into the last group. Social keys understood by the site: x, facebook, linkedin, github, email, website, telegram, discord, medium, youtube, instagram, reddit, mastodon, keybase, bluesky. Any other key renders as a plain labeled link.
